definition: coding mutation reducing or eliminating enzyme function in pigment pathway
notes: Do not assume high pleiotropy if expression/function is tissue specific.

definition: cis-regulatory change altering expression of a pigment pathway enzyme
change at an enzyme controlling pigment branch identity/hydroxylation
notes: Important for blue/red and pigment-type shifts; chemistry must be typed.

definition: coordinated or repeated change in downstream pigment deployment genes
notes: Maps naturally to Camellia A-module and Iochrominae late-gene convergence.

definition: change in upstream genes shared with non-anthocyanin flavonoids
notes: Potential pleiotropic effects through flavonols and other flavonoids.

definition: regulator with relatively specific control over floral pigment programme
notes: Do not merge activator and repressor direction.

definition: bHLH/WDR or other regulator with broader developmental targets
notes: Specificity must be documented, not inferred from family name alone.

definition: change in copigment/shared flavonoid production affecting colour or signal
notes: Visible white can retain this module.
Never infer from visible yellow without chemistry.

definition: aurone/chalcone or other typed yellow-pigment mechanism
examples: aurone;chalcone;betalain not applicable to most focal clades

definition: change in a competing branch redirecting shared precursor flux
notes: Generalizes Camellia P/F logic without forcing literal A/F/C/P equivalence.

definition: change in post-biosynthetic decoration that alters pigment hue/stability
notes: Required for cases such as Petunia exserta where reduced acylation contributes to red hue without changing the core anthocyanidin class.

definition: cellular transport, vacuolar pH or localization change affecting colour

notes: Retain unknown; never impute from visible phenotype.
